scope: Synthetic native DrawingData submission in Unicorn; host intercepts RequestDraw and manually invokes native draw on the native-created request. No real queue execution, ownership, Matrix4, GPU paint, saved page or device behavior.
limitations: Host supplies initialized flag, empty completion list, synthetic bitmap methods, bitmap reference and allocation callbacks, context adapters, and a RequestDraw callback; the intercepted request is manually drained. This run also constructs an unused preliminary AsyncDrawingData before submission. Host runtime and transitive harness dependencies are not fully pinned.
